truths.truth: A fresh ingest into an empty data directory creates the store with no migration error, and status then prints real counts
truths.evidence: Spot-check with HEAD target/debug/terminus, HOME, TERMINUS_CONFIG_DIR, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and TERMINUS_DATA_DIR all in fresh scratch dirs (data dir created empty): `ingest tests/fixtures/session-basic.jsonl` exit 0 with empty stderr; `status` printed `sessions       1` and `turns          8`.

truths.truth: With TERMINUS_DATA_DIR naming a missing directory, status and verify exit 0, print nothing on stdout and the reason on stderr, create nothing, and the --json documents carry ok true, the reason and every data field at zero or null
truths.evidence: Wiring: lib.rs:146,148 dispatch to cmd::verify::run and cmd::status::run; status.rs:41 calls super::read::open(), verify.rs:14 calls read::open_in(&super::data_dir()?, Config::default()); read.rs:103-107 maps Store::open_read_only's StoreNotFound (open.rs:241-248, metadata probe only) to Opened::Nothing, handed to read::empty (status.rs:43 with nothing() at status.rs:165-177; verify.rs:15-20). Spot-check against a nonexistent scratch data dir: `status` and `verify` exit 0, stdout empty, stderr `terminus: no terminus store at <dir>/terminus.db; nothing has been archived yet`; `status --json` exit 0, {"command":"status","data":{"excluded":null,"last_run":null,"sessions":0,"size_bytes":0,"store":null,"turns":0,"watermark_bytes":0,"watermarks":0},"ok":true,"reason":"no terminus store at ..."}; `verify --json` exit 0, data {checked:0, failures:[]}, ok true, the same reason; the data dir did not exist after any of the four runs. Tests status_with_no_store_says_so_and_creates_nothing, status_json_with_no_store_is_a_reason_zeroes_and_nulls and verify_against_no_store_is_a_reason_and_creates_nothing pass in the full-suite run.

truths.truth: A terminus.db with no tables gets the no-store answer from status, verify and the other read commands and still holds no tables afterwards; a terminus.db holding a table but no meta still fails as not a terminus store
truths.evidence: read.rs:112-116 returns Opened::Nothing for Error::NotAStore only when terminus_core::store::holds_no_tables(data_dir) is Ok(true) (open.rs:423-434, a read-only open counting sqlite_master tables), every other NotAStore stays Failure::Operational (read.rs:117); re-exported at store/mod.rs:11. Spot-check: a 4096-byte terminus.db that Python set to journal_mode=wal and closed with no table: `status`, `status --json`, `verify`, `verify --json`, `search --project * x` and `sessions --project *` all exit 0 with the no-store reason (JSON documents identical in shape to truth 2), and the file still had 0 tables afterwards. A terminus.db with `CREATE TABLE other (x)`: all four status/verify runs exit 1 with `exists but is not a terminus store (reading meta.archive_format: no such table: meta)`. Unit tests a_database_with_no_tables_is_a_reason_and_creates_nothing, a_database_with_a_foreign_table_is_operational, a_meta_table_with_no_versions_is_operational and integration tests status_on_a_database_with_no_tables_says_no_store_and_creates_nothing and verify_against_a_database_with_no_tables_is_no_store pass.

truths.truth: On a format-2 store older than the binary, status and verify exit 0, print the stale-store line on stderr in both modes, and leave sqlite_master and every PRAGMA table_info unchanged
truths.evidence: The stale line comes from read.rs:120-122 (store.predates_this_build(), open.rs:388-390). Spot-check: ingested store aged with Python (meta.derived_schema set to 4, DERIVED_SCHEMA is 5 at open.rs:58; ALTER TABLE decisions DROP COLUMN compacted, dropped), schema recorded as all 131 sqlite_master rows plus pragma_table_info rows. The pre-phase binary (built from git archive 3900fed) on the same aged store printed no stale line and the schema changed: `decisions` came back with `compacted INTEGER, dropped TEXT`. Tests status_on_an_older_store_says_so_and_changes_nothing, verify_on_an_older_store_says_so_and_changes_nothing and json_mode_keeps_stdout_pure_and_warnings_on_stderr (now sweeping the first five DATA_COMMANDS, cli.rs:1430) pass.

truths.truth: With a malformed terminus.toml, verify on a clean store exits 0 and reports no failures

gaps.name: A no-table database read leaves SQLite sidecars while the phase says it creates nothing
gaps.reason: behavior wrong vs claim - a read of a no-table WAL database leaves terminus.db-shm and an empty terminus.db-wal, but the new doc comment, two new test names and the docs say the read creates nothing, and AC1 extends 'create nothing' to this case
gaps.evidence: Observed: one `status` run against a no-table terminus.db with no sidecars left terminus.db-shm (32768 bytes) and terminus.db-wal (0 bytes). Claims: crates/terminus-core/src/store/open.rs:421 (`creates, writes and repairs nothing`); crates/terminus/src/cmd/read.rs:308 and crates/terminus/tests/status.rs:437 (test names ending `creates_nothing`; both only count tables); docs/commands.md:110,122 (`and creates nothing`). The risk_surface review raised it (ADJUDICATION-risk_surface-plan-1.json, ruling survived), and it was left unfixed with no issue reference. No table or store is created; the sidecars are the same ones D-10 accepts for every read-only open of an ordinary store.
gaps.missing: Pick one: (a) reword the holds_no_tables doc at open.rs:420-422, rename the two `creates_nothing` no-table tests, and qualify docs/commands.md:110,122 so they say the read creates no table and no store and can leave SQLite's -shm and empty -wal, as D-10 records; or (b) file an issue carrying the review finding and reference it. Do not change Store::open_read_only (D-01).
